spans.s:
यौतक n. (-कं) A nuptial gift, presents made to a bride, at her marri-
age, by her father or friends; some consider it also implying a
gift to the bridegroom.
 E. युतक the same, pleonastic aff. अण् ।

यौतव n. (-वं) Measure in general.
 E. योतु the same, अण् aff.; some
authorities read यौवत and पौतव ।
